risks.title: Rapid changes in consumer preferences
risks.score_rationale: The apparel, footwear, and accessories industry is subject to rapid changes in consumer preferences. Success depends on accurately anticipating demand and successfully introducing new products. (Item 1A, Risk Factors)

risks.title: Intense competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive market with established players and new entrants. The footwear and apparel industry is highly competitive. (Item 1A, Risk Factors)

risks.title: Macroeconomic and geopolitical risks
risks.score_rationale: Volatile economic conditions, inflation, tariffs, and geopolitical tensions create a complex and challenging environment. Evolving U.S. trade policy risks introduce uncertainty and volatility. (Item 7, MD&A - Trends and Uncertainties)

risks.title: Inventory management
risks.score_rationale: The company must manage inventory efficiently to meet consumer demand, avoid overstocking and stockouts, while maintaining product assortment alignment.

risks.title: Supply chain and sourcing risks
risks.score_rationale: The company relies entirely on independent third-party manufacturers and is exposed to disruption risks. Diversification across manufacturers and regions reduces but does not eliminate these risks. (Item 1A, Item 7)

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data protection
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cyberattacks, customer data loss, and operational disruptions. E-commerce and digital operations present increasing risks.

risks.title: Trade policy and tariff risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks from high tariffs and import restrictions from certain regions. Mitigation strategies include selective price increases and cost-sharing negotiations. (Item 7, MD&A - Trends)

ai_positioning.summary: The company DECK does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related topics in its 10-K report for the 2025 fiscal year. There is no indication of initiatives, integration, or risks related to AI.
